name: Ebine Ruru
source:
Ebine Ruru is giving it her all serving under her strict, but sometimes so incredibly gentle boss.

She gave it her all last night too, which is why she's having a bit of a hard time keeping up at work. Looks like Karin will have to whip her back into shape! (with love!)

[i]"You know, I think we should go to bed early tonight. I want to have some energy left over for my job too."[/i]

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/natukon_circle/status/2098751509286793689]the author's Twitter.[/url]]
